title: Exceptions: salvo que, excepto si, a no ser que
goal: Name the one exception to a rule with salvo que, a no ser que, salvo si and excepto si.
grammar: salvo que, excepto si, a no ser que

items: I can use *a menos que*, *a no ser que* and *salvo que* + subjunctive.
I can use *salvo si* and *excepto si* + indicative.
I can use the imperfect subjunctive for an exception in the past.
